Spend the night in a unique hostel in Amsterdam! Welcome to the Train Lodge
Just a few years ago our train carriages were part of the Zürich – Rome night train. Because these sleepers are even more comfy when they are not on the move, we decided to create a hostel Amsterdam had never seen before. In creating this unique hostel on wheels we tried to keep all the original features and fittings to give you an authentic train experience.
Looking for a hostel in Amsterdam? Our Train Lodge is an affordable, unique and strategic base to explore all Amsterdam has to offer. Anyone who has ever visited this city will agree: Amsterdam is the
place to be! Cosmopolitan and lively, yet friendly and laid-back, this city will steal your heart. You will find the same vibe in the Train Lodge, perfect for solo travelers and groups alike! Instead of hotelrooms you sleep in the original compartments, a real train experience!
You’ll find us right next to train station Amsterdam Sloterdijk, close to train, tram, bus and subway connections. Schiphol Airport is 15 minutes away. The city centre takes a couple of minutes by train. Alternatively, do as the Dutch do and rent a bicycle. Thanks to our strategic location, other cities and sights in Holland are just a train ride away: Utrecht, Den Haag, Rotterdam, Haarlem, Zaandam and Zandvoort are all easily accessible (in under 40 minutes).
Compartment Types
A perfect and affordable place to stay for solo travelers, couples, families and groups
Private room 3/6 people
Berth in a mixed compartment
Berth in a "ladies only" compartment
Carriage for 33 people
Private compartment 3/6 people
The Train Lodge has a total of 132 beds, in 44 compartments. Each compartment has 3 stacked beds. You can easily climb to your bed using the specially designed ladder. If you prefer more privacy for you and your fellow traveler(s), you can also reserve the entire compartment. By combining 2 compartments we can create a bigger compartment with 6 beds perfect for families.
More information
Book now!
Berth in a mixed compartment
The Train Lodge offers a total of 132 berths, divided over 44 compartments. We started with half the capacity, 66 berths, divided over 22 compartments. A comfy bed with fresh linens awaits you in a shared or private compartment. You can reserve a berth in 2 combined compartments, each with 3 stacked beds. There is room for 6 people.
More information
Book now!
Berth in a ''Ladies only" compartment
No need for snoring men? Why not book a berth in one of our 'ladies only compartments'? We have combined 2 compartments into one, with 3 stacked beds on each side. You'll share your compartment with a maximum of 5 other girls.
More information
Book now!
Carriage for 33 people
Where to stay if you want to explore Amsterdam with a whole bunch of friends, family, fellow students or colleagues? Why not just book your own carriage at the Train Lodge? A carriage has 11 compartments, each with 3 stacked beds. Climb the top bed with our specially designed ladder. Alternatively, we can combine 10 compartments into 5 with beds for 6 people each. Let's get this party started!
